support_spans: lupus nephritis requiring hemodialysis
scaly, crusted pink plaques that involved the periorbital skin
Punch biopsy from the left upper eyelid demonstrated vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy
concepts.why: The patient's history of lupus nephritis and the presence of scaly, crusted pink plaques with vacuolar interface dermatitis on biopsy are consistent with Discoid Lupus Erythematosus.

support_spans: acute myeloid leukemia
scaly, crusted pink plaques that involved the periorbital skin
contradict_spans: Punch biopsy from the left upper eyelid demonstrated vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy
concepts.why: The patient's history of acute myeloid leukemia and the presence of scaly, crusted pink plaques are consistent with Cutaneous Leukocytoclastic Vasculitis, although the biopsy results do not support this diagnosis.

support_spans: lupus nephritis requiring hemodialysis
hydroxychloroquine (resulted in retinal toxic effects)
lenalidomide (severely worsened platelet count, with a nadir of 28 ×10^3/μL)
concepts.why: The patient's history of lupus nephritis and the adverse reactions to hydroxychloroquine and lenalidomide are consistent with Drug-Induced Lupus Erythematosus.
It explains the uncovered finding of deep vein thrombosis.
It explains the uncovered findings of immune thrombocytopenia and diverticulitis, which can be associated with this condition.
